context: Tests whether the agent correctly structures an out-of-tree LLVM 22 NPM pass plugin, including the class hierarchy, CMake configuration, plugin registration entry point, and lit test conventions.

checklist.name: PassInfoMixin base class
checklist.description: The pass class inherits from PassInfoMixin<ClassName> (not FunctionPass, ModulePass, or any legacy base class)

checklist.name: run() return type
checklist.description: The run() method returns PreservedAnalyses (not bool or void)

checklist.name: Plugin entry point name
checklist.description: Defines a function named llvmGetPassPluginInfo with extern "C" linkage (and optionally LLVM_ATTRIBUTE_WEAK)

checklist.name: Pipeline registration callback
checklist.description: Uses PB.registerPipelineParsingCallback (or equivalent PassBuilder registration) inside the plugin info lambda

checklist.name: CMake llvm_map_components_to_libnames
checklist.description: CMakeLists.txt uses llvm_map_components_to_libnames() to resolve LLVM library names (not hardcoded -lLLVMCore or similar)

checklist.name: CMake find_package LLVM 22
checklist.description: CMakeLists.txt uses find_package(LLVM 22 REQUIRED CONFIG) to locate LLVM

checklist.name: MODULE or pass plugin CMake target
checklist.description: CMakeLists.txt uses add_llvm_pass_plugin() OR add_library(...MODULE...) with POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON (not add_executable or add_llvm_component_library)

checklist.name: No using namespace llvm in header
checklist.description: The .h header file does NOT contain 'using namespace llvm' at file scope

checklist.name: Lit test smoke RUN line
checklist.description: The .ll lit test file contains a RUN line that invokes opt with -disable-output (smoke test for crash-free execution)

checklist.name: Lit test plugin load syntax
checklist.description: The .ll lit test RUN line uses --load-pass-plugin=%llvmshlibdir/... or an equivalent substitution to load the plugin

checklist.name: CHECK-LABEL in lit test
checklist.description: The .ll lit test uses CHECK-LABEL: (not bare CHECK:) to anchor patterns to specific function definitions

checklist.name: No legacy pass manager APIs
checklist.description: Implementation does NOT use legacy::PassManager, FunctionPass, ModulePass, AU.setPreservesAll(), or getAnalysis<>() anywhere
